description: Header file defining the PrivilegedRequest class and its nested classes, managing privileged descriptor requests and offers via domain sockets, including socket handling, descriptor management, and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: PrivilegedRequest
classes.description: Main class managing privileged descriptor requests and offers, including nested Descriptor and Connection classes.

classes.name: PrivilegedRequest::Descriptor
classes.description: Represents a file descriptor, manages duplication and closing of descriptors.

classes.name: PrivilegedRequest::Connection
classes.description: Handles domain socket connections, request/offer messaging, socket setup, and message processing.

methods.name: PrivilegedRequest::Descriptor::operator int
methods.description: Returns the underlying descriptor as an int.

methods.name: PrivilegedRequest::Descriptor::Move
methods.description: Transfers ownership of the descriptor, invalidating the current descriptor.

methods.name: PrivilegedRequest::Descriptor::Move(int&&)
methods.description: Sets the descriptor to a new value, closing the previous if necessary.

methods.name: PrivilegedRequest::Connection::Request
methods.description: Performs a request to obtain descriptors from the server.

methods.name: PrivilegedRequest::Connection::Open
methods.description: Opens a domain socket connection for listening.

methods.name: PrivilegedRequest::Connection::Read
methods.description: Reads and processes incoming socket messages.

methods.name: PrivilegedRequest::Open
methods.description: Opens the privileged request channel with an identifier.
